rule: HARD z=0 centerline rule (handoff item 8): sideSign*z_pelvis >= 0 for every candidate attachment and mount anchor at EVERY evaluated pose. sideSign = +1 (right side of record). Enforced as hard constraint centerline_z0 in fr_objective.m:131-143 (zmin over all rows/poses, cvec = -zmin) via fr_rowZPelvis fr_objective.m:411-417 (fr_chainT into the pelvis frame); sideSign definition in objective_spec.json hard_constraints[0]. The rule is per-attachment-side; seeds may not switch sides (no sign flips or absolute values).
